title: Layer 2 round 1 minor collector: shell trust posture and diagnostics
description: (1) security: glob match fail-open on overlapping prefix/suffix (substrate.rs:89). (2) security: tilde expansion trusts HOME and mis-falls-back to repo-root when HOME unset, turning ~/ entries into misleading absent-artifact failures (substrate.rs:117-118) — SE converges. (3) security: chassis stdout flows unsanitized into terminal-destined display fields (acquire.rs:93). (4) security+SE: the git failure Diagnostic ships empty recovery members and a hardcoded token against the vocabulary discipline, renders an empty machine-form file field, and leaks absolute paths via message — the #730 clause applies to refs.rs's Diagnostic construction (refs.rs:95,100). (5) security: PATH-resolution trust posture undeclared for both subprocess sites — state it (a malicious crosslink/git on PATH is the operator's environment, likely out of model — but say so). (6) security nit: binding-failure detail embeds both absolute roots in Status-destined prose (substrate.rs:47) — the #730 clause. (7) QE: local_refs origin-stripping/HEAD-filter/dedup has no test. Owner: security/software-engineer. Validator: solution-architect.
